title: IFRA convenes member company leadership in Shanghai
summary: Senior representatives from IFRA member companies across Greater China and North Asia met in Shanghai, China, on 16 September 2026 for a discussion on global trade dynamics and the association’s strategic priorities.

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회가 글로벌 무역 역학 및 전략적 우선순위를 논의하기 위해 상하이에서 회원사 리더십 회의를 소집했다.
